title: The composition that does not work, kept so the docs can prove it
description: docs/src/content/docs/cite/set-up/require-citations.mdx says a house schema cannot reach the citations vocabulary through $ref, because only the bundled built-ins are registered for reference resolution and citations is not one of them. This file is that attempt. Validating anything against it is exit 2 with a compile error, which is the page's evidence.
